note: Same prospect and same assessment as the 30 May call, now confirmed by outcome rather than inferred. Self-employed in mortgage lending, health the long-neglected area, not the deconditioned gym-averse profile the ICP excludes. The income criterion failed exactly as read on Saturday — 'it was never in my budget and I can't come up with the money' — and it failed at $4,000 as well as at $6,000, which shows the constraint is household liquidity rather than the discount. He also remains a rebuild rather than a good-to-great case. This pair of calls is the cleanest available test of the ICP's income criterion: a prospect who matches on everything except affordability, worked with a complete process and two price reductions, still does not buy.
